milestone.title: M24.13 manual smoke checklist sign-off (HUMAN GATE)

intent.outcome: master-plan-bkp/smoke-checklist.md is signed off by a human on a real macOS machine. v1.0.0 stable tag is unblocked. Any failing smoke item is captured as a follow-up milestone so the work is tracked, not silently deferred.

problem.description: M24 code steps (24.1-24.12) are complete but 24.13 is a manual smoke gate that cannot be executed by an agent. Without human sign-off, v1.0.0 stable release is blocked. This milestone defines what 'signed off' means and what happens on failure.

in_scope: Human runs master-plan-bkp/smoke-checklist.md end-to-end on macOS.
Human annotates each checklist item as pass/fail and commits the signed-off file.
For any failing item: open a follow-up mp milestone sized to fix that item; record each failure as a separate milestone (one failure -> one milestone).
All follow-up milestones link back to this milestone as their parent (via depends_on).
M08 verdict = pass when zero items failed. M08 verdict = blocked when at least one item failed; unblock after follow-up milestones close.
After M08 pass: cut v1.0.0 stable tag from wip HEAD and repeat the tap-bump dance (separate milestone or M06-extension).
out_of_scope: Implementing fixes for failing smoke items (handled by the follow-up milestones opened as part of this milestone's outcome).
Re-running automated tests (the smoke gate is in addition to, not a replacement for, go test ./...).
Cutting v1.0.0 stable tag (separate decision after M08 passes).
Migrating smoke-checklist.md out of master-plan-bkp/ (it is read-only archival context).

acceptance_criteria.description: Every item in master-plan-bkp/smoke-checklist.md is annotated as pass (or has a follow-up milestone opened for the failure, with the milestone referencing the failing item).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: git log --oneline -- master-plan-bkp/smoke-checklist.md shows a commit after the run; each [ ] in the file is either [x] (pass) or paired with a follow-up milestone id; follow-up milestones all show execution_status=done OR this milestone is in 'blocked' state with the failure list captured

acceptance_criteria.description: If any smoke item failed, a follow-up milestone exists for each failure with intent/scope/AC that fix that specific item.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: mp list milestones --filter ... shows one follow-up per failing item; each follow-up's intent.problem references the failing smoke item
